classes.name: Guardian
classes.description: Draws enemy fire. Protects the party.
classes.hint: Feeds BLIGHT payoffs. Pairs: Mage Molten Armor, Shaman Bulwark.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.hint: Consumes MARKED/BLIGHT for recovery. Pairs: Rogue Shadow Mend.

classes.name: Mage
classes.hint: Detonates CONDUCTIVE and primes Rogue combos.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.hint: Consumes MARKED, applies BLIGHT, chains with Mage and Cleric.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.hint: Applies CONDUCTIVE. Pairs with Mage, Ranger, Guardian.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.hint: Applies MARKED. Pairs with Rogue Ambush and MARKED payoffs.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.hint: Consumes MARKED/BLIGHT for heals and control. Chains with Bard and Warlock.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.hint: Turns CONDUCTIVE into BLIGHT. Chains with Bard and Paladin.

classes.name: Bard
classes.hint: Applies MARKED/CONDUCTIVE, extends statuses, and amplifies Finale.
